questions.question: A man engaged a servant on a condition that he would pay him Rs. 80 and a pair of jeans after service of one year. Servant served for only 9 months and receives a pair of jeans and an amount of Rs. 55. The price of the jeans is _______
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the cost of jeans be Rs. x

Total amount paid after service of one year = 80 + x

Amount paid after service of one month = (80 + x)/12

Amount paid after service of 9 months = {(80 + x)/12} × 9

According to the question:

⇒ 55 + x = (240 + 3x)/4

⇒ 220 + 4x = 240 + 3x

⇒ x = 20

**∴ The price of the jeans is Rs.20**

If the arithmetic mean of two numbers is 7 and the geometric mean of the same two number is 2√10. Then find the numbers x and y respectively, such that x > y.
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Arithmetic Mean = 7

Geometric Mean = 2√10

**Formula used:**

Arithmetic Mean = (x + y)/2

Geometric Mean = √xy

(x - y)2 = (x + y)2 - 4xy 

**Calculation:**

Arithmetic Mean = 7

⇒ (x + y)/2 = 7

⇒ x + y = 14 ----(1)

Geometric Mean = 2√10

⇒ √xy = 2√10

⇒ xy = (2√10)² = 40 ------(2)

Now,

⇒ (x - y)² = (x + y)² - 4xy

⇒ (x - y)2 = 14² - (4 × 40)

⇒ (x - y)2 = 196 - 160 = 36

⇒ x - y = 6 ----(3)

Now, adding equation (1) and (3) we get

⇒ 2x = 20

⇒ x = 10

Now, by equation (2)

⇒ xy = 40

⇒ 10 × y = 40

⇒ y = 4

**∴ The correct answer of (x, y) = (10, 4).**

questions.question: The perimeter of two similar triangles is 36 units and 48 units. Find the ratio of their corresponding areas.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of the first triangle = 36 units

The perimeter of the second triangle = 48 units

**Formula used:**

(Perimeter of the first triangle)/(perimeter of the second triangle) = (Side of the first triangle)/(side of the second triangle).

**Calculation:**

(Side of the first triangle)/(side of the second triangle) = (perimeter of the first triangle)/(perimeter of the second triangle)

Side of the first triangle/side of second triangle = 36/48 = 3/4

Area of the first triangle/Area of the second triangle = (side of first triangle/side of second triangle)²

Area of the first triangle/Area of the second triangle = (3/4)² = 9/16

**∴ The correct answer is 9/16.**

questions.question: If side of a square is increased by 60%, then what will be the percentage increase in its area?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let a be the side of a square.

So, the area of the square = a²

New side = a + {(60/100) × a} = (160/100) × a = 1.6a

So, area of new square = (1.6a)² = 2.56a²

Percentage increase in its area = (2.56a² - a²)/a² × 100 = 156%

**∴ The correct answer is 156%.**

questions.question: The average of ten numbers is 18. If one number is removed, then the average becomes 16, then what is the removed number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 10 members = 18

The average of 9 members = 16

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of the given data/number of data

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

Average of 10 numbers = 18

⇒ sum of 10 numbers/10= 18

⇒ Sum of 10 numbers = 180

One number is removed, then total 9 numbers are left.

.Average of 9 numbers = 16

⇒ sum of 9 numbers/9 = 16

⇒ Sum of 9 numbers = 144

Required number = 180 - 144 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36**

questions.question: A sum becomes 1.69 times of itself in 2 years when invested at compound interest. What is the per annum rate of interest (in percentage)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount = 1.68 × Principal

Time = 2 years

Formula used:

Amount = P × {1 + (r/100)}ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Let the principal be Rs. P

Amount = 1.69 × Principal

⇒ P{1 + (rate/100)}² = 1.69 × P

⇒ {1 + (rate/100)}² = 1.69

⇒ 1 + (rate/100) = 1.3

⇒ (rate/100) = 1.3 - 1

⇒ rate = 0.3 × 100

⇒ rate = 30%

**∴ The correct answer is 30%.**

questions.question: Rohan sells two articles. The cost price of the first article is equal to the selling price of the second article. The first article is sold at a profit of 40% and the second article is sold at a loss of 40%. What is the ratio of the selling price of the first article to the cost price of the second article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost price of the first article is equal to the selling price of the second article.

**Calculation:**

Let the C.P of the first article be Rs. X

Profit % = 40%

So, Selling price = X + 40% of X

= x + 0.4x = 1.4x = 7x/5

And, the selling price of the second article = Rs. X

Loss % = 40%

Cost price = Selling price + loss % of cost price

⇒ (1 - loss%) cost price = selling price

⇒ (1 - 0.4)Cost price = X

⇒ 0.6 cost price = X

⇒ Cost price = x/0.6 = 5x/3

Required ratio = (7x/5) ∶ (5x/3) = 21 ∶ 25

**∴ The correct answer is 21 ∶ 25.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Calculation:

The first article sold at 40% profit = C.P : S.P = 5 : 7

The second article sold at 40% loss = C.P : S.P = 5 : 3

According to the question:

C.P : S.P = (5 : 7) × 3 = 15 : 21

C.P : S.P = (5 : 3) × 5 = 25 : 15

So, S.P of the first article: C.P of the second article = 21 : 25

∴ The correct answer is 21 ∶ 25.

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 2400. It is sold at two successive discounts of 10% and 15%. What is the selling price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Effective discount = {10 + 15 - (10 × 15)/100}% = 23.5%

Marked price = Rs.2400

Selling price = 2400 - 23.5% of 2400

⇒ 2400 - 564 = Rs.1836

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.1836.**

questions.question: P and Q are at a distance of 240 km from each other at 9: 00 a.m. After 1 hour, P starts moving towards Q at a speed of 25 km/hr. At 11 a.m. Q starts moving towards P at the speed of 18 km/hr. At what time (in p.m.) will they meet?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The distance between P and Q = 240 km

Speed of P = 25 km/h; Speed of Q = 18 km/h

**Calculation:**

Distance between P and Q at 10 : 00 am = 240 km

Distance covered by P in 1 hour = speed × time = 25 × 1 = 25 km

Distance between P and Q is at 11 am = 240 - 25 = 215 km

Relative speed = 25 + 18 = 43 km/hr

Time taken to meet = distance/ speed = 215/43 = 5 hr

∴ They will meet at 11 am + 5 ho

questions.question: The area of an equilateral triangle is 16√3 cm². Find its side (in cm).

 Area of an equilateral triangle = (√3/4) × side2

⇒ side = 8 cm

questions.question: Calculate the area (in cm²) of a circle whose diameter is 14 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of circle = 14 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of circle = π × r²

**Calculation:**

Diameter of circle = 14 cm

Radius = diameter/2 = 14/2 = 7 cm

Area = π × radius² = (22/7) × 7² = 154 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 154 cm2.**

questions.question: Find the volume (in cm³) of a hemisphere of diameter 28 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of hemisphere = 28 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3) × π × radius3 

**Calculation:**

Diameter of hemisphere = 28 cm

Radius = diameter/2 = 28/2 = 14 cm

Volume = (2/3) × π × radius³

Volume = (2/3) × (22/7) × 14³ = 5749.33

**∴ The correct answer is 5749.33 cm³.**

questions.question: ∆DEF is right angled at E. If m∠F = 60°, then find the value of (cotD - 2/√3).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∆DEF is right angled at E.

∠DFE = 60°; ∠DEF = 90° 

**Formula used:**

Cot 30° = √3

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5478fab8dc6b528737d19d27f0c76d30691503cd1c2131bda0961f77632365d5.png] 

By angle sum property,

∠D + ∠E + ∠F = 180° 

⇒ ∠D = 180°- (∠E + ∠F)

⇒ 180°- (90° + 60°) = 30°

Cot D - (2/√3)

⇒ cot30° - (2/√3)

⇒ √3 - (2/√3)

⇒ (3 - 2)/√3 = 1/√3

**∴ The correct answer is 1/√3.**

questions.question: ∆DEF is right angled at E. If Tan D = 12/5, then what is the value of sec F?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Tan D = 12/5

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ca1a2919f2c4acaa057abcd9abb41352796d13b1c5989778049766f8d9d89e2.png] 

⇒ EF/DE = 12/5

⇒ EF = 12k and DE = 5k

Now, by Pythagoras theorem,

⇒ DF = √(EF² + DE²) = √(144k² + 25k²) = 13k

Now,

Sec F = DF/EF = 13k/12k = 13/12

**∴ The correct answer is 13/12.**
